newsitem.title: USA: UST sees higher Q4, year earnings.
newsitem.headline: UST sees higher Q4, year earnings.

text.p: UST Inc said Tuesday it expects earnings per share for the 1996 fourth quarter of $0.61, up nine percent from a year ago.
For the full year, earnings are expected to be $2.42 a share, up 12 percent from 1995 but slightly lower than expected, it said.
UST said lower than expected unit volume for moist smokeless tobacco was the primary reason for the earnings per share shortfall in both periods.

UST said unit volume for the fourth quarter fell about 3.0 percent from the same period in 1995, while unit volume for the full year fell about 2.0 percent, including the effect of an additional shipping day.
UST said complete financial results will be released on January 22.
